Hi Gina —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and the asks we captured on the call so both sides have a single source of truth. Please reply to confirm the specifics below so our legal and platform teams can prepare the addendum and configuration checklist.

Recap / your asks:
- Pilot scope: inference-only for transaction routing assistant; no model tuning or supervised training using Fintegral customer data.
- Data residency: US-West (preferred region: us-west-2).
- PII handling: Fintegral will redact direct identifiers before sending where possible; Redwood to enforce additional filtering for the following sensitive fields: SSN, full credit card numbers, and unredacted government IDs.
- Logging & retention: request is for operational logs only (request IDs, error traces). Proposed default retention = 30 days; please confirm if 30 days is acceptable or if you require 45 days.
- Access controls & audit: role-based access only; Redwood will provide audit logs scoped to your tenant and monthly SOC2 artifact access upon request.
- Contractual: we will produce a short DPA addendum (training exclusion clause + logging retention) and a DocuSign flow for signatures.

Attachments referenced on call: Fintegral_Security_QA_2026.pdf (your questionnaire copy), Docusign_NDA_Link.txt (placeholder link we can reuse).

Next steps (from Redwood):
1) I will send this note to legal + security to draft the DPA addendum and routing policy.
2) Marissa will kick off the technical onboarding and setup a pilot config with region restriction and PII redaction hooks.
3) Neha will gather SOC2/audit artifacts and share any existing redaction recipes we have for payment fields.

Please confirm in a quick reply the items in bold below: 
- Confirmed: Redwood will NOT use Fintegral customer data to improve or train models (yes/no)
- Data residency: us-west-2 (confirm or state other)
- Log retention: 30 days or 45 days (which do you prefer)

If you confirm, legal and I will circulate the DPA addendum draft by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Marcus Lin

Subject: Re: Post-call: data handling confirmation and training exclusion (Fintegral pilot)

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming items from our side below so you have an explicit record for legal: 

- Confirmed: Fintegral requires that Redwood DOES NOT use any Fintegral customer data to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve underlying models. This includes any derivatives or embeddings derived from customer-supplied content.
- Data residency: Confirmed — all inference and any short-term telemetry must remain in us-west-2.
- PII handling: Fintegral will redact direct-identifiers before sending to Redwood where feasible. Additionally we require Redwood to apply in-line redaction for SSNs and full card numbers; tokenized card references (last4) are acceptable.
- Logging & retention: We prefer 45 days for operational logs for troubleshooting and compliance. Logs should exclude payload content beyond metadata/trace ids.
- Audit & artifacts: Fintegral requests SOC2 Type II evidence and a copy of the DLP/PII handling checklist as part of onboarding. Please provide links for the SOC2 report under NDA.

We are comfortable with an internal DPA addendum that includes a training-exclusion clause. Legal is happy to review Redwood's draft — attaching the signed product SOW and our internal questionnaire (attached).

Attachment: Signed_Product_SOW.pdf

Please proceed with the addendum and share the DocuSign flow once ready.

Gina Torres
Head of Integrations, Fintegral
